title: Put the harness package's suites in the per-tick gate
description:
The harness package 43y created runs lint, typecheck and tests in CI (ci.yml 'harness conformance and replay'), but the per-tick gate's ts cell is cloudflare format, lint, contracts and tsc only. So a tick could merge with the harness suite red. One test's timeout bound (dumb-git-origin under the 300 s discipline guard) was found red at base by five workers and absorbed five times (h3c, 7oy, 4ao, omq, 30e). Add the harness suite to [testing.commands], or at least its fast half, and measure its wall time against the gate bound first, as t8u's tc9 asks for cloudflare vitest.
evidence: .tick/runners.toml:220 (ts command); .github/workflows/ci.yml:410-412

ticfac run epic-43y created this tick by absorbing the finding bf280200414f42c5a8562abacc26d1a799205cb2090339c18f72ce545549931f (reported by run-epic-43y/tick-j2k/attempt-69): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A5. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-43y/absorptions/bf280200414f42c5a8562abacc26d1a799205cb2090339c18f72ce545549931f.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-10-06 01:36 - ticfac run epic-43y: created by absorbing finding bf280200414f42c5a8562abacc26d1a799205cb2090339c18f72ce545549931f — placed before the close-out, which does not start while it is open; the review had already run. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-43y/absorptions/bf280200414f42c5a8562abacc26d1a799205cb2090339c18f72ce545549931f.json on epic/43y, and it says: the classifier put 0.87 of its probability mass on the items rather than on none, at or above the deliberately cheap absorb threshold of 0.35, and named A5: a false positive costs the epic work it did not need, a false negative closes an epic whose goal is unmet in a factory where nobody is watching, and those are not the same cost — the threshold sits on the cheap side
